visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair and bangs wearing a purple button-down shirt sits at a wooden table inside a restaurant. She gestures with a small white object while speaking to the camera. The background shows a modern restaurant interior with warm lighting, brick accents, and other patrons. (2) The camera switches to close-up shots of various Middle Eastern dishes on a table, including a tray with roasted chicken and potatoes, a bowl of yellow lentil soup, a basket of round flatbreads, and a plate of stuffed vine leaves decorated with pomegranate seeds. (3) The woman is shown tearing open a flatbread, which is hollow inside, and using a spoon to fill it with pieces of chicken and potato. She takes a bite and gives a double thumbs-up while pink heart graphics float around her. (4) A young man with curly dark hair wearing a dark patterned shirt is shown eating the chicken wrap and expressing surprise and delight. He continues to eat and discuss the food while sitting opposite the woman. (5) The woman demonstrates how to eat the lentil soup by squeezing a fresh lemon into it and adding long green leaves. The man is seen adding small crunchy croutons to his soup bowl. (6) Both individuals taste the stuffed vine leaves; the woman looks shocked, and the man has a strong negative reaction, leaning forward and appearing to struggle with the salty taste. (7) The scene shifts to the man at a payment counter, handing a credit card to a staff member in a blue uniform. The screen displays the total cost and final rating.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, medium-tempo electronic BGM starts immediately. A female voice speaks with high energy and clarity, introducing a game concept. Background restaurant chatter is very faint. (2) Music continues as the female voice describes the food items. A percussive 'ding' sound effect highlights the text overlays. (3) Eating sounds (soft crunches) and satisfied 'mm' vocalizations are heard alongside the music. (4) A male voice joins in, expressing surprise with a higher pitch and slightly increased volume. Female laughter is heard in response. (5) Bubbling/pop sound effects accompany the demonstration of eating soup. The female voice remains the primary narrator, with a helpful and friendly tone. (6) A sharp cartoonish 'shock' SFX occurs as they taste the vine leaves. The male speaker's voice drops in pitch and becomes slightly muffled as he reacts to the taste, followed by a 'clatter' of a spoon. (7) The music reaches a rhythmic peak as the card reader emits a short, high-pitched digital beep. The male voice says 'Thank you' in English with a bright, positive inflection before the audio cuts out.
